parameters.name: ListenerPort
parameters.description:
The frontend port that is used by the CLB instance.

Valid values: **1 to 65535**.

parameters.name: ListenerProtocol
parameters.description:
The frontend protocol that is used by the CLB instance.

>  This parameter is required if the same port is used by listeners of different protocols.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the CLB instance is created.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~27584~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb start-load-balancer-listener --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp13jaf5qli5000000000 --listener-port 80 --listener-protocol https --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
